latest_release.body:
Rolls up 299 commits / 116 merged pull requests since 0.1.18, plus 21
pull requests whose work landed through maintainer commits, from 26
contributors.

The headline is research that outlives the chat that produced it. A finished
analysis can be saved as a versioned research artifact with its evidence
references and data-as-of date, searched later, and revised instead of
overwritten; a follow-up turn or a later session finds the backtests already
run through `list_backtest_runs` and reads their artifacts instead of running
them again; and a research goal's objective can be edited without losing its
evidence. Paper trading adds an opt-in A-share five-minute simulation that
settles a completed session bar by bar on a new order lifecycle, with
JoinQuant's limit-fill rules; saved accounts still settle daily. Gildata
financial queries, report-period stock screening and Shannon portfolio
diagnosis arrive as separate opt-ins for Gildata account holders, Gildata
quotes are used only when named, and the QVeris integration is removed.
Argentina (BYMA shares and CEDEARs) joins as a backtest market, `web_search`
can use Parallel's hosted search, and Codex OAuth lists the models the
signed-in account offers. Both 0.1.18 regressions are fixed: a retried
provider error no longer halts live decisions for the day, and a research
goal's answer that crosses its token budget is delivered. Most of the rest is
correctness: formula corrections to GTJA and Qlib alphas, futures contract
specifications and fees, loader paging and ticker forms, grounding of
document figures and their units, background tasks that belong to the session
that started them and survive a restart, and chat channels that no longer
call a voice transcriber that does not exist. The Web UI gets a new welcome
screen and a warm paper palette in light and dark.

Upgrading: a stored QVeris key is no longer read, and a `GILDATA_TOKEN` alone
no longer enables any Gildata feature. Pick the features in Settings → Data
Sources or `VIBE_TRADING_GILDATA_FEATURES`.

### Added

- **Versioned research artifacts** (#2079, #2159, thanks @he-yufeng; closes
  #1909, #2158). A finished analysis can be saved as an immutable revision
  with its subject, universe, data-as-of date, evidence references,
  verification status and optional hypothesis, goal, session or run links,
  through the `save_research_artifact` / `search_research_artifacts` /
  `get_research_artifact` agent tools, `vibe-trading research-artifact
  save|search|show|revision`, `/api/research-artifacts` and a Web page in all
  eleven languages. Passing an `artifact_id` appends a linked revision; the
  subject and universe cannot change. Repeating identical content and
  provenance returns the existing revision, and changed content or evidence
  defaults to `unverified`: saving is not verification and does not make old
  data fresh. The index lives in the runtime `sessions.db` unless
  `VIBE_TRADING_RESEARCH_ARTIFACT_DB_PATH` names another file; the idempotency
  lookup is indexed (#2159). The REST save route accepts at most 1,000
  evidence objects (1,000,000 characters serialized) and ids of at most 200
  characters.

- **`list_backtest_runs` finds the backtests earlier turns and sessions
  already ran** (#2074, thanks @zeus229), so a follow-up reads their artifacts
  with `read_run_artifact` instead of re-running them. It lists runs from the
  `req.json` and `run_card.json` the runtime already writes, newest first and
  paged, with each backtest's absolute `run_dir`; the agent tool defaults to
  the current session, the MCP tool to every run. Assistant replies in the
  history carry `[prev_run: <id>]`. The grounding gate adopts a prior run read
  this way only when its run card and `metrics.csv` agree and every table it
  registers matches the run card manifest hash. The session filter is not an
  access control (runs have no owner), and a run the model forged in an
  earlier turn is not detected.

## ✨ Key Features

## 💡 What Is Vibe-Trading? Vibe-Trading turns finance questions into research reports, runnable backtests and paper portfolios. You can also authorize a supported broker to execute live trades within a mandate you set and can halt. Your funds stay with the broker. ## ✨ What You Can Do | Task | Where to start | |---|---| | Research markets, filings or uploaded documents | Ask in Web chat or [attach a report](guides/research.md#upload--analyze-documents). | | Backtest a strategy or benchmark alphas | Inspect charts and trades in Run Detail, or compare factors in `/alpha-zoo`. | | Simulate trading or replay a journal | Track daily fills and NAV in `/paper-trading`. Use `/journal` and `/shadow` in the CLI to review your trades. | | Combine accounts or compare allocations | Open `/portfolio` for holdings and proposed allocation changes. [Broker support](#broker-support-at-a-glance) | | Explore options and correlations | Open `/options` for multi-leg payoffs and Greeks, or `/correlation` for market regimes. | | Coordinate or repeat research | Run a [Swarm team](guides/research.md#swarm-workflows), assign work in Pixel Office or schedule a brief in `/scheduled`. | | Revisit research with dated evidence | Search `/research-artifacts`, compare any two revisions, and export a full series or selected comparison as JSON or Markdown. [Versioned research](guides/research.md#versioned-research-artifacts) | ## ⚡ Quick Example Once you have run `vibe-trading init`, you can ask for a backtest in plain English or benchmark an existing alpha library from the terminal. ```bash vibe-trading run -p "Backtest a BTC-USDT 20/50 moving-average crossover for 2024. Compare it with buy-and-hold and report maximum drawdown." vibe-trading alpha bench --zoo gtja191 --universe csi300 --period 2018-2025 --top 20 ``` Open **Run Detail** to compare the crossover with buy-and-hold, inspect the trades behind a drawdown and check the data source on the run card. ## 🧪 Research Workflow | Step | In the crossover example | |---|---| | Plan | Identify the trading pair, date range, moving averages and benchmark from the prompt. | | Ground | Fetch historical bars for BTC-USDT. Check the source and dates before interpreting the result. | | Execute | Write the strategy and run the backtest. The run directory holds the strategy, trades and equity curve. | | Validate | Compare the result with buy-and-hold. Inspect turnover, drawdown and validation warnings alongside return. | | Revisit | Open the saved run or ask a follow-up with different parameters. You can also save a dated research conclusion and revise it when new evidence arrives. | ## 📡 Data Sources & Smart Fallback The loader supports **28 market-data sources**. With `source: "auto"`, it infers the market from the symbol and tries the configured sources in order. | Market | How a request is filled | |---|---| | A-shares and Hong Kong | Start with Tencent. If it cannot supply the bars, try Eastmoney and then the remaining sources for that market. | | US equities | Start with Yahoo. Stooq and Sina are the next two sources in the chain. | | Crypto | Try OKX, Binance and CCXT before falling back to other sources. | | Futures | Chinese contracts can use AKShare or local bars. Supply local bars for global contracts. | You can also choose a source explicitly. For example, installing `vibe-trading-ai[ashare]` adds the token-free BaoStock loader for daily A-share bars. The [data source reference](guides/capabilities.md#-data-sources--smart-fallback) lists the full chains and credential requirements. ## 🔩 Detailed Capabilities ### Market research | Feature | What you can do | |---|---| | Filings and holdings | Compare a manager’s SEC 13F holdings across quarters, or look through an ETF to its underlying positions. Each holdings report carries its reporting date. | | Company valuation | Use `/dcf` to see how a valuation changes with the discount rate and terminal growth. Use `/comps` for peer multiples, or build a linked three-statement model and export the results to Excel. | | Papers and documents | Search arXiv and OpenAlex for a signal, inspect the authors’ definition, then test it on your own universe. Upload a filing, spreadsheet or slide deck for questions about a specific exhibit. | | Stock screening | With Gildata enabled, screen companies by market cap and retrieve half-year revenue in one request. Screening and portfolio factor diagnosis each have their own opt-in. | ### Quant research | Feature | What you can do | |---|---| | Alpha Zoo | Benchmark signals from Qlib, Alpha101, GTJA and the academic and fundamental libraries. Compare information coefficients across horizons, then check whether the result survives a walk-forward test. | | Backtest engines | Model A-share price limits, crypto funding or futures margin. Use a shared capital pool for a cross-market strategy and inspect the individual fills behind its returns. | | Options Lab | Build a spread leg by leg. Compare its expiry payoff with the Greeks and see how the position responds to a change in spot price and implied volatility. | | Portfolio risk | Inspect drawdowns, estimate value at risk and expected shortfall, or use Brinson attribution to separate allocation from stock selection. The correlation view shows when markets start moving together. | | Strategy tracking | Register a strategy with its evidence and track how its Sharpe ratio or factor information coefficient changes as new results come in. | ### Accounts and trading | Feature | What you can do | |---|---| | Portfolio | Bring read-only broker holdings into one snapshot or import an extraETF export. Enter target weights to preview the value change for each holding. | | Paper trading | Advance a saved account one trading day and inspect fills, cash and NAV. You can also replay an A-share session in five-minute steps in a separate simulation. The `paper_trade_reconcile` agent/MCP tool independently checks fees, cash, positions and NAV arithmetic without market or broker access. | | Shadow Account | Import your broker’s trade journal, inspect fees and trading habits, then compare the actual trades with a rule-based replay. | | Broker connections | Set up a connection in the CLI or Web and test it with a read. For supported live profiles, set symbol, order and exposure limits before enabling trading. The kill switch halts live activity. | ### Teams and recurring research | Feature | What you can do | |---|---| | Swarm and Pixel Office | Run a bull–bear investment committee or a quant research desk and inspect the workers’ reports. In Pixel Office, assign a task to a teammate and record the result on the shared board. | | Scheduled briefs | Start from a premarket brief, an earnings tracker or a portfolio checkup. Choose a schedule and send the report to a configured channel such as Slack, Telegram or email. | | Research history | Search older sessions and reopen a saved run. Save a dated conclusion with its evidence and compare revisions when the investment case changes. | | Run records | Inspect the data source, model, execution record and metric references behind a backtest. Reopen the saved trades and equity curve to check a reported figure. | ### Broker support at a glance

## 🚀 Quick Start **Terminal.** Install the package with Python 3.11+, choose a model provider in the setup wizard, then open the interactive CLI. ```bash pip install vibe-trading-ai vibe-trading init vibe-trading ``` **Web app.** Docker serves the frontend and API together at `http://localhost:8899`. From a fresh checkout, configure your provider before starting the container. ```bash git clone https://github.com/HKUDS/Vibe-Trading.git cd Vibe-Trading cp agent/.env.example agent/.env # Set your provider and API key in agent/.env. docker compose up --build ``` The PyPI package includes the CLI, API and MCP server. For a frontend development setup or a local model, see the [installation guide](guides/installation.md). ## 🖥 CLI Reference Start `vibe-trading` for the interactive terminal. Type `/help` at the prompt to browse commands or use these shortcuts during research. | Command | Use it to | |---|---| | `/model` | Switch the provider or model for the session. | | `/history` | Browse and resume a prior conversation. | | `/show ` | Inspect the results of a saved run. | | `/pine` | Export the current strategy as a Pine Script indicator. | From the shell, `vibe-trading alpha list` browses the factor libraries and `vibe-trading playbook list` shows the scheduled research templates. ## 💡 Examples - **Compare stocks.** Ask “Compare AAPL and MSFT over 2024. Which month accounts for the largest gap in returns?” Resume the conversation later with `/history`. - **Review your trades.** Use `/journal` to analyze your exported trade history, then `/shadow` to compare your trades with a rule-based alternative. - **Run an investment committee.** Choose a stock and follow the bull and bear cases through to the final report. ```bash vibe-trading --swarm-run investment_committee '{"target":"TSLA","market":"US"}' ``` ## 🌐 API Server Start a local server with `vibe-trading serve --port 8899`. In a second terminal, run `curl http://localhost:8899/runs` to list saved runs. Use the returned ID with `GET /runs/{run_id}` to inspect its results. | To run a research session over HTTP | Endpoint | |---|---| | Create the conversation | `POST /sessions` | | Send the research question | `POST /sessions/{id}/messages` | | Follow progress as it happens | `GET /sessions/{id}/events` | Open `http://localhost:8899/docs` to try the endpoints interactively. [Authenticated clients](guides/cli-and-api.md#security-defaults) send the API key in the `Authorization: Bearer` header. ## 🔌 MCP Plugin MCP clients can launch the same package over stdio. Add this entry to Claude Desktop’s `claude_desktop_config.json`, restart the client and call `list_skills`. ```json { "mcpServers": { "vibe-trading": { "command": "vibe-trading-mcp" } } } ``` For other clients or a custom output directory, see the [MCP configurations](guides/mcp.md). ## 🏛 Ecosystem Vibe-Trading is part of the **[HKUDS](https://github.com/HKUDS)** agent ecosystem:

## 💡 Vibe-Trading 是什么？ 把金融问题变成研究报告、可运行的回测或模拟投资组合。你也可以授权支持的券商在指定限额内执行实盘交易，并随时叫停。资金始终留在券商账户。 ## ✨ 你能做什么 | 任务 | 从哪里开始 | |---|---| | 研究市场和文件 | 在 Web 对话中提问，或[上传报告](guides/research.md#upload--analyze-documents)。 | | 回测策略或比较因子 | 在 Run Detail 查看图表与成交，或在 `/alpha-zoo` 比较因子。 | | 模拟交易或复盘 | 在 `/paper-trading` 跟踪每日成交与净值，用 CLI 的 `/journal` 和 `/shadow` 复盘。 | | 汇总账户或比较配置 | 在 `/portfolio` 查看持仓和调整建议。[券商支持](#券商支持一览) | | 分析期权或相关性 | 在 `/options` 查看多腿损益和希腊字母，在 `/correlation` 观察市场状态。 | | 组织或定时运行研究 | 运行 [Swarm 团队](guides/research.md#swarm-workflows)，在 Pixel Office 分工，或在 `/scheduled` 安排简报。 | | 回看研究证据 | 在 `/research-artifacts` 搜索带日期的[研究版本](guides/research.md#versioned-research-artifacts)，比较任意两个修订，并将完整系列或选定比较导出为 JSON 或 Markdown。 | ## ⚡ 快速示例 运行 `vibe-trading init` 后，可以用自然语言发起回测，也可以从终端评测已有因子库。 ```bash vibe-trading run -p "回测 BTC-USDT 在 2024 年的 20/50 均线交叉策略，与买入持有比较，并报告最大回撤。" vibe-trading alpha bench --zoo gtja191 --universe csi300 --period 2018-2025 --top 20 ``` 打开 **Run Detail** 对比策略与买入持有，查看回撤期间的成交和运行卡片上的数据源。 ##
